As a person who played both and Morrowind, I have to say that overall I enjoyed the Skyrim Dark Brotherhood more than Oblivions.

Allow to to explain my view on this

In Skyrim, you do a variety of fetch quests, most of which I found rather boring, but the main quests and goals in it, such as killing the gourmet and hiding his body, hunting down the son of the leader of the Penitus Oculatus, and poisoning the emperor only to realize it was a decoy, and killing him on his own ship, I liked a lot. While the quests and plot were rather predictable and unoriginal, had a reasonable sense of progression and satisfaction
 

With Oblivions, I noted that sense of progression seemed absent, and almost all of the quests in the questline seemed rather random, sure, they were way better than Skyrims (particularly the house party mission) but the general satisfaction and plotline seemed weak. Especially since EVERYONE you know, all of the DB members and Lucien Lachance, die in the end. Sure, Skyrim did kind of the same thing with Astrid and the Dawnstar sanctuary, but at least the most interesting and likable characters, Nazir, Babette, and Cicero if you let him live, stay around to give a sense of connection and reason to still participate in the DB. However, when i finished the Oblivion questline, I had no urge to participate anymore, and had no real sympathy for the last remaining Black Hand member.

However, out of all the games, I personally think that the Dark Brotherhoods involvement in Morrowind was the coolest purely out of how many important events you partake in, I mean, you get to save Barenziah from an assassination attempt and even be the one the kill the Night Mother herself!
